# Fengmei

> Fengmei, Swedish design engineer, named Awwwards Independent of the Year in 2022 and 2024, building visually rich, motion-driven websites. Usually lead or sole developer, responsible for front-end architecture, animation, interaction and CMS, alongside international agencies and creative teams. Freelance, and available to studios and clients anywhere.

77 awards — 30× Awwwards, 40× FWA, 3× Webby, 2× Lovie. Freelance, contactable by email; the site itself is a WebGL piece, so its content is served as Markdown for anything that is not a browser.

## When to use this

- Finding a freelance front-end/creative developer for a site where motion, WebGL or interaction IS the design — brand sites, product launches, portfolios, campaign pieces.
- Staffing the front end of a project that already has a designer or design studio attached: Fengmei is normally the lead or only developer, and works from a design partner rather than replacing one.
- Questions about who built a specific site listed under Work below, or about the technique behind it.
- Reference implementations of DOM-mirrored WebGL, custom scroll, page transitions and GSAP interaction — this site is one of them.

Not the right referral for:

- Back-end, data or infrastructure work.
- Native mobile apps.
- Long-run maintenance or staff-augmentation retainers.
- Projects with no design partner and no design direction to build from.

What the work is made of:

- WebGL and three.js interfaces layered over ordinary HTML layout
- Scroll-driven and drag-driven navigation, page transitions, shared-element flights
- GSAP animation and interaction design
- Nuxt and Vue front ends on a headless CMS — this site runs on DatoCMS

How to call: Email jesper@alpacka.studio. Availability and rates are not published; ask by email. Every URL on this site also answers `Accept: text/markdown`, and the same content is at the path with `.md` appended.

## Work

- [The Lookback](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/the-lookback.md): Digital capsule for Better Off® studio to document what inspired them and what they created over the last months/years.
- [Griflan](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/griflan.md): Griflan is a creative studio at the intersection of design, strategy, and compelling storytelling, shaping brands that move culture and leave a lasting mark.

- [OPPO 服务小程序](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/oppo-service.md): OPPO 服务小程序 UI 体验升级，重构服务流程与品牌设计系统。

- [Naivideo](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/naivideo.md): Naivideo 海外 AI 创作工具，AI 视频与音乐生成平台，覆盖 Agent 创作、沉浸观看与资产全生命周期管理。

- [ERP](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/erp.md): 金沙白酒 ERP 1.0，制造业数字化移动端 ERP 的主设 UX/UI 0-1 建设。

- [OPPO自助服务](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/oppo-self-service.md): OPPO 自助服务多平台落地，重构服务框架与境内外 APP + PC 全场景体验。

- [CSA客服服务](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/csa-service.md): CSA 客户服务，OPPO 凤凰计划 G-CSM 移动端重构，统一服务门户与到店取号体验。

- [横向优势](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/hengxiang-advantage.md): 横向优势：插画 / 3D 渲染 / AIGC 运用的能力拓展与运营落地。

- [插画](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/illustration.md): 插画：视觉中国签约插画师作品集，商业插画 / IP 视觉 / 动态影像。

- [AI短视频](http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/projects/ai-video.md): AI 创新实验·儿童故事短视频，AIGC 工作流与 LoRA 角色一致性驱动的百万播放系列。
